_comment: DrawStack authenticated QA surface — 5 pages requiring active Clerk session
_note: All pages require GC (General Contractor) role. Log in as steve@alpinepropertygroupllc.com before running.

pages.label: Projects List
pages.why: The primary GC landing page after login. Layout regressions here are immediately visible to every user on every session. Project cards, nav sidebar, and header are visually sensitive.
pages.check: Left sidebar present, projects grid/list rendered with cards, 'New Project' button visible, no blank panels

pages.label: Draws List
pages.why: Core product surface. The draws list is the primary operational view for GCs. Status badges, amounts, and action buttons must render correctly — regressions here affect active billing flows.
pages.check: Draws table/list present, status columns visible, amounts formatted, filter controls intact

pages.label: Invoices
pages.why: Subcontractor payment tracking. Invoice upload/parse UI and the invoice table are high-risk for visual regressions after any payment or file-handling changes.
pages.check: Invoice list visible, upload UI present, amount columns formatted, status badges intact

pages.label: Settings
pages.why: Company profile, billing, and white-label settings. Regressions here can silently break user configuration flows. Settings forms are often broken by Clerk or Stripe component updates.
pages.check: Settings form fields visible, save buttons present, billing section renders, no blank sections

pages.label: Lender Portfolio
pages.why: The lender-facing portfolio view. This page uses a different data layout and is the most likely to have visual regressions when lender features ship. Covers the lender side of the product.
pages.check: Portfolio cards or table visible, project summary panels render, no empty state errors where data exists
pages._note: URL is /dashboard/portfolio — accessible from GC account but renders lender-style portfolio view
